summary: Release lifecycle, recovery controls, and safe OS self-upgrade / 发布生命周期、恢复控制与安全自升级

excluded: Automatic human approval, merge, tag, Release, production rollback, or Git history rewrite / 自动人工批准、合并、tag、Release、生产回滚或 Git 历史改写
Automatic resolution of ambiguous both-modified upgrade conflicts / 自动解决双方同时修改的歧义升级冲突
deferred: v1.0 end-to-end mature-project rescue certification / v1.0 成熟项目端到端救援认证

safety.destination: Current private GitHub repository and GitHub Release
safety.review_disposition: Owner passed v0.8.0 UAT and approved the current private GitHub publication transaction on 2026-08-26.

rollback.plan: Use a dedicated branch to restore the prior immutable OS package while preserving local overrides, audit history, Linear mappings, safety dispositions, discovery evidence, and runtime/private context.
rollback.verification: Run upgrade verification, strict validator, all tests, private safety gate, and project-specific UAT before accepting the rollback.

known_limitations: GitHub latest-release discovery requires network access; directory, zip, and metadata sources work offline.
Ambiguous both-modified files require human conflict resolution.
The free Linear workspace issue limit requires a Project Document as the temporary equivalent requirement record for AIPOS-045 through AIPOS-051.
Owner accepted the documented limitations during v0.8.0 UAT.
